_doc: Indicator registry for the Danish makro view. `db` = '' (Statistics Denmark), 's20' (Finans Danmark) or 's30' (Copenhagen). `level` = finest geography the indicator natively exists at. `calc` describes the post-processing in build_makro.py. `hue` = RGB target for the choropleth ramp (paper #EFF2EE → hue). `pull` names a raw file when one table is fetched with several selections. `SUM` = omit the variable so the API returns its total. `TODO:word` = placeholder; validate_config.py lists codes whose label contains the word. `direction` = 'higher_better' | 'lower_better' — which end of the scale is favourable (ranking and good/bad colouring). `note` = glossary text for the indicator's details. `chip` = true puts the indicator in the quick-pick chip row. Rolling-quarter calcs (Safety): `rolling4q_per_1000_pop` = sum of the numerator over the latest 4 quarters ÷ FOLK1A population at the same end quarter × 1000; `rolling4q_per_1000_dwellings` = same sum ÷ BOL101 dwellings of the latest year × 1000; `rolling4q_yoy_pct` = latest 4Q sum vs the 4 quarters before, %. For the yearly history each calendar year is filed as its Q1–Q4 sum (÷ population at Q4); the live value is the rolling 4Q ending at the latest quarter. A `select` value may be a list of codes (rows matching any of them are summed). `history_from` = first year of the yearly history (Charts axis; default: history_years back from the latest year); `map_from` = first year offered by the map/table year selector, and the start of the quarterly rolling series; `breaks` = series breaks drawn in Charts, [{at: '2013K3' | '2023', text}].

indicators.label: Population growth
indicators.desc: Population change over the last 12 months, % (same period previous year).
indicators.source: DST FOLK1A (municipality, quarterly) · POSTNR1 (postal code, 1 Jan)

indicators.label: Disposable income, avg per person
indicators.desc: Average disposable income per person, DKK/yr (INDKP101, all persons).
indicators.warn: Published with ~11-month lag.

indicators.label: Median equivalised disposable income
indicators.desc: Median equivalised disposable income (5th decile).

indicators.label: Young adults 20–34
indicators.desc: Residents aged 20–34 as % of population.

indicators.label: Single-person households
indicators.desc: Single-person households as % of all households.

indicators.label: Housing-benefit households
indicators.desc: Households receiving housing benefit (boligsikring/boligydelse, December) as % of households.
indicators.warn: All housing-benefit types (boligsikring incl. students and boligydelse for pensioners); student cities and municipalities with many pensioners score high.

indicators.label: Private rental rent
indicators.note: Scraped annually from boligstat.dk; computed by the ministry from Boligstøtteregister × BBR (87 % coverage). Analogue of the Finnish Kela rent.
indicators.desc: Average rent DKK/m²/yr in private rental dwellings (private udlejningsboliger i alt, all construction years).
indicators.source: Social- og Boligstyrelsen, boligstat.dk Huslejestatistik — computed from the housing-benefit register × BBR
indicators.warn: Based on households receiving housing benefit, upscaled to the stock (≈87 % coverage); skews to the cheaper end — asking rents in the market are typically higher. Small municipalities suppressed.

indicators.label: Social housing rent (almene)
indicators.desc: Average rent DKK/m²/yr in social (almene) family dwellings, 1 Jan 2026.
indicators.source: Landsbyggefonden, Huslejestatistik 2026, Tabel 7 (100 % coverage via Huslejeregisteret)

indicators.label: Rented dwellings
indicators.desc: Rented dwellings as % of occupied dwellings.
indicators.warn: DST counts residents of cooperative dwellings (andelsboliger) as tenants, so in Copenhagen ~⅓ of the stock is 'rented' via andel. Private rental + almene + andel together.

indicators.label: Unemployment rate
indicators.desc: Registered unemployed as % of the labour force (provisional, latest month).

indicators.label: Higher education
indicators.desc: Residents 15–69 with short-, medium- or long-cycle higher education, %.

indicators.label: Multi-dwelling buildings
indicators.desc: Dwellings in multi-dwelling buildings as % of all dwellings.

indicators.label: Immigrants and descendants
indicators.desc: Immigrants and descendants as % of population.

indicators.label: Realised price, owner-occupied flats
indicators.desc: Realised sale price of owner-occupied flats, DKK/m², mean of last 4 quarters.
indicators.warn: Postal codes with few trades are suppressed by the source; small-n quarters are noisy.

indicators.label: Asking → realised discount
indicators.desc: (first asking price − realised price) / asking price, %, mean of last 4 quarters.

indicators.label: Days on market, sold flats
indicators.desc: Days on market of sold owner-occupied flats, mean of last 4 quarters.

indicators.label: Homes for sale
indicators.desc: Homes listed for sale per 1,000 dwellings (latest month).

indicators.label: Homes for sale (number)
indicators.desc: Number of homes (houses + owner-occupied flats) listed for sale, latest month. The per-1,000 version above normalises this by the dwelling stock.

indicators.label: Dwellings completed, last 4Q
indicators.desc: Dwellings completed in the last 4 quarters per 1,000 dwellings.
indicators.warn: Not adjusted for reporting delays — recent quarters are revised upward.

indicators.label: Dwellings completed, last 4Q (number)
indicators.desc: Number of dwellings completed in the last 4 quarters (all uses, all developers). The per-1,000 version above normalises this by the dwelling stock.
indicators.warn: Not adjusted for reporting delays — recent quarters are revised upward.

indicators.label: Social housing share
indicators.desc: Social housing (almene boliger) as % of all dwellings.

indicators.label: Average dwelling size
indicators.desc: Average floor area per dwelling.

indicators.label: Rented dwellings (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings registered as rented (enh045 = 1, includes andel) as % of dwellings with a known tenure — BBR unit register, postal-code level.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Unoccupied dwellings (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings registered as 'not in use' (enh045 = 3) as % of dwellings with a known tenure. Owner-reported and slow to update — use as a relative signal between areas, not as a vacancy rate.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Average dwelling size (BBR)
indicators.desc: Mean registered dwelling area (enh026), all dwellings.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Small dwellings < 50 m² (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings under 50 m² as % of dwellings with a registered area — the studio / one-room segment.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Dwellings built 2010+ (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings in buildings commissioned 2010 or later (byg026) as % of dwellings with a known year.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Multi-dwelling buildings (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings in multi-dwelling buildings (byg021 = 140) as % of dwellings.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Dwellings per building (BBR)
indicators.desc: Dwellings divided by residential buildings — building scale: 1–2 = houses, 10+ = blocks.
indicators.warn: BBR snapshot (no history). Owner-reported register data; tenure 'rented' includes cooperative (andel) dwellings.

indicators.label: Reported crime · per 1,000 inh.
indicators.desc: Penal-code offences (straffelov i alt) reported in the municipality over the latest 4 quarters, per 1,000 inhabitants.
indicators.source: DST STRAF11 (reported offences by place of offence, quarterly) · FOLK1A
indicators.note: Place of offence (gerningskommune). Reported offences — reported ≠ solved. Excludes the traffic law. Series breaks: 2007 (police reform), 1 July 2013 (new definition of sexual offences), 2023 (~1,700 animal-welfare reports missing nationally). Not seasonally adjusted — hence rolling 4 quarters.

breaks.text: 1 July 2013: Criminal Code amendments on sexual offences (more offences classed as rape, §216) — series break in the penal-code total (DST footnote, STRAF11/STRAF22).

indicators.label: Violent crime · per 1,000 inh.
indicators.desc: Reported crimes of violence (forbrydelser mod liv og legeme) over the latest 4 quarters, per 1,000 inhabitants.
indicators.source: DST STRAF11 (reported offences by place of offence, quarterly) · FOLK1A
indicators.note: Place of offence (gerningskommune). Reported offences — reported ≠ solved. Excludes the traffic law. Series breaks: 2007 (police reform), 1 July 2013 (new definition of sexual offences), 2023 (~1,700 animal-welfare reports missing nationally). Not seasonally adjusted — hence rolling 4 quarters.

indicators.label: Property crime · per 1,000 inh.
indicators.desc: Reported offences against property (ejendomsforbrydelser) over the latest 4 quarters, per 1,000 inhabitants.
indicators.source: DST STRAF11 (reported offences by place of offence, quarterly) · FOLK1A
indicators.note: Place of offence (gerningskommune). Reported offences — reported ≠ solved. Excludes the traffic law. Series breaks: 2007 (police reform), 1 July 2013 (new definition of sexual offences), 2023 (~1,700 animal-welfare reports missing nationally). Not seasonally adjusted — hence rolling 4 quarters.

indicators.label: Residential burglaries · per 1,000 dwellings
indicators.desc: Reported residential burglaries (indbrud i privat beboelse) over the latest 4 quarters, per 1,000 dwellings (BOL101, latest year).
indicators.note: Place of offence (gerningskommune). Reported offences — reported ≠ solved. Excludes the traffic law. Series breaks: 2007 (police reform), 1 July 2013 (new definition of sexual offences), 2023 (~1,700 animal-welfare reports missing nationally). Not seasonally adjusted — hence rolling 4 quarters.

indicators.label: Drug and weapons offences · per 1,000 inh.
indicators.desc: Reported offences against the Euphoriants Act (3210) and the Weapons Act (3410) over the latest 4 quarters, per 1,000 inhabitants.
indicators.source: DST STRAF11 (reported offences by place of offence, quarterly) · FOLK1A
indicators.note: Place of offence (gerningskommune). Reported offences — reported ≠ solved. Excludes the traffic law. Series breaks: 2007 (police reform), 1 July 2013 (new definition of sexual offences), 2023 (~1,700 animal-welfare reports missing nationally). Not seasonally adjusted — hence rolling 4 quarters. Driven largely by police activity (stop-and-search, visitation zones, targeted operations) rather than by underlying incidence.
indicators.warn: Police-activity driven: a high value can reflect enforcement effort, not more offences.

indicators.label: Reported crime · y/y %
indicators.desc: Penal-code offences reported over the latest 4 quarters vs the 4 quarters before, %.
indicators.note: Place of offence (gerningskommune). Reported offences — reported ≠ solved. Excludes the traffic law. Series breaks: 2007 (police reform), 1 July 2013 (new definition of sexual offences), 2023 (~1,700 animal-welfare reports missing nationally). Not seasonally adjusted — hence rolling 4 quarters.

breaks.text: 1 July 2013: Criminal Code amendments on sexual offences (more offences classed as rape, §216) — series break in the penal-code total (DST footnote, STRAF11/STRAF22).

indicators.label: Penal-code reports with a charge · %
indicators.desc: Penal-code reports in the year that led to a charge (sigtelse), as % of all penal-code reports (annual).
indicators.note: Place of offence (gerningskommune). Reported offences — reported ≠ solved. Excludes the traffic law. Series breaks: 2007 (police reform), 1 July 2013 (new definition of sexual offences), 2023 (~1,700 animal-welfare reports missing nationally). Annual table; charges are counted for the reports of the same year, so the latest year can still rise as cases are processed.

breaks.text: 1 July 2013: Criminal Code amendments on sexual offences (more offences classed as rape, §216) — series break in the penal-code total (DST footnote, STRAF11/STRAF22).

cph._doc: Copenhagen quarter (kvarter, 67 areas) layer from Københavns Kommune's statbank (api.statbank.dk/v1/s30). Same calc engine as indicators; OMRKK codes 20101–21211 are kvarterer, 1001–1010 bydele. Geometry: wfs-kbhkort.kk.dk k101:kvarter (CC BY 4.0).
